seo.metaDescription: Fishing off Koh Lanta on a longtail, or on a private wooden raft in Ao Lanta with a seafood lunch cooked on board. Raft from 3,900 THB.

draft.title: Fishing Trip Koh Lanta – Longtail or Private Raft

lead: A half day of fishing the way the island does it: from a longtail off the coast, or from a private wooden raft in the calm waters of Ao Lanta, with lunch cooked on board.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel around 9:30, check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier at 10:00.
The raft crosses the mangrove forest.
A look at how the local fishermen live and work.
Seafood lunch cooked on the raft, drinks and fruit.
More fishing, swimming or photos, back at the pier at 14:00 and transfer to your hotel.

legacyText.title: Fishing Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Two versions. The longtail goes out to sea off Koh Lanta with a local captain. The raft stays in the sheltered bay of Ao Lanta, on the mangrove side, and the crew cooks fresh seafood on board for lunch.
legacyText.cardDescription: A fishing trip on a longtail off the coast of Koh Lanta.
goodToKnow: The raft is private, from one or two people. From three people the price is per person. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The longtail trip is a half day too. Tell us which one you prefer, or ask us which suits your group.
legacyText.priceNote: For the longtail version, ask us for the price.
legacyText.caption: Sunset catch
